name: Bennelong Point and East Circular Quay: the buildings round the Opera House

buildings.why: Bennelong Apartments, East Circular Quay's northern block ('the Toaster'): fifteen storeys in OpenStreetMap, and as high as the Opera House's shells are half way up from the bridge and Circular Quay West (dan-freeman, angus-waters). The map had 13 m.
East Circular Quay's block between Bennelong Apartments and Opera Quays, a storey under them in the same photos. The map had 12 m.
Opera Quays, East Circular Quay's southern block over its colonnade: twelve storeys in OpenStreetMap (dan-freeman, angus-waters). The map had 6 m.
Government House in the garden, two storeys of sandstone under its battlements (dan-freeman, nico-smit-8Rk1DqL_Lkc). The map had 6 m.
